meaning: The 'registered scheduler' is software that alone decides the order and timing of every post-capture retrieval (source metadata pages, identity-stage lead groups, eligibility-stage units). A human may start it but not choose URLs, order or retries. It never schedules vendor API calls, accounts or agent runs.

frozen_requirement.source_metadata_stage: for GitHub-hosted discovered sources, metadata (repository, licence, commits <=T0, default-branch tree) is retrieved only through the GitHub REST API or git over HTTPS, which GitHub's terms permit for research; off-GitHub officially linked pages are fetched only if robots.txt (RFC 9309) permits the path. Otherwise Freeze-1.1 limits apply: at most four pages per source (landing, about/governance, data-format/export, revision/history), one request plus one retry on transient failure, 30 s timeout. The three non-landing URLs come only from the two adjudicators' agreed selection of raw landing links (byte-smallest where several qualify); disagreement => SOURCE_UNRESOLVED.
frozen_requirement.identity_stage: lead groups in byte order of canonical JSON lead sets; BFS over first-party links whose path contains a frozen term; max depth 2; max 16 distinct pages; 2 MiB per page; 30 s per request; one retry only on timeout/429/5xx after 30 s; redirects max 3; fragments and utm_*/gclid/fbclid removed
frozen_requirement.eligibility_stage: same BFS parameters per canonical unit in canonical-ID byte order
frozen_requirement.cache: mandatory shared cache of identical response bytes; each unit charged a slot per use
frozen_requirement.no_discretion: no search engines, no archive search, no script execution, no guessed URLs, no extra pages
frozen_requirement.clock: system UTC corrected by SNTP as in the capture runner; every request logs scheduled and actual time
frozen_requirement.window: identity and eligibility capture within the seven-calendar-day window starting 00:00 UTC the day after source lock; a missed deadline blocks the whole batch
frozen_requirement.failure: failed, blocked, oversized or unsupported pages consume a slot and are recorded; no rolling extension
frozen_requirement.audit_log: append-only JSONL with request, response metadata, byte sha256 and budget consumption per unit; hashed at stage end
frozen_requirement.access_policy: RFC 9309 robots.txt is honoured for every host; a disallowed or robots-unverifiable page consumes its slot and is an evidence gap (Freeze 1.1 'blocked pages'), never circumvented. OPEN QUESTION (blocks registration of this role): the terms basis for automated retrieval and retention of vendor documentation pages in the identity/eligibility stages has not been established. It is the same class of concern that withdrew Bing, and it must be resolved by a prospective rule before G3.
